ios.desc:
GraphCalcPro2Go is an advanced scientific calculator, offering features found on expensive handheld calculators, but with additional capabilities not possible with handhelds, thanks to iOS.

Features include:
• No ads.  Ever.
• Ultra high precision and range
• Intuitive and easy to use
• Standard (in-fix) and RPN modes
• Built-in constants and unit conversions
• iCloud sync

With iCloud sync, you can synchronize your calculation history with GraphCalcPro2Go on all your iOS devices, and with GraphCalcPro on your Macs.

Sharing feature allows you to share your calculation history with other users running GraphCalcPro2Go on their iOS devices and GraphCalcPro on their Macs.

Additionally, you can create beautiful graphs with GCP2Go at the touch of a button.

And now, you can run GCP2Go on your Apple Watch.  GCP2Go on Apple Watch has the precision, performance, and all the scientific functions available on the iOS version - and graphing capability!  Sync constants, and optionally history, between GCP2Go on your iPhone and your Apple Watch.

Premium upgrade adds additional features, including:
• Graph multiple equations simultaneously
• Graph printing and sharing
• Additional built-in constants, fully customizable
• iCloud sync and sharing of user constants

quotes.text:
My calculator is bc -l in a terminal but I'd bet that there are calculator apps with network access to display ads, sync to the same app on other devices, save past calculations to the cloud, and get plugins.

I found one with some of those features and some more, with only one minute of googling https://apps.apple.com/us/app/graphcalcpro2go/id1091870099

That's for iOS but why not on Windows or Android? I'd be surprised to find one like that on Linux.
